setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Intense guitar peaks occurred in the solo section of this song; This song and Estimated Prophet were very freshly minted that night [9][15]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Described as an otherworldly, powerful, and solid acid jam; Listener decided the band was worth hearing after this song played [7][13]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): Jerry Garcia used an octave effect on one lead spot [9]
- **Samson and Delilah** (1 review): Listener states this performance of the song was smoking [8]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Listener says this performance lays waste to everything in its path [10]

## The recordings

- **gd77-05-13.sbd.miller.9393.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 154 min; rated 4.54/5 by 61 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the recording as having superior sound quality; Listener calls the recording great and the jams contained within sweet [5][8]
- **gd1977-05-13.sbd.ashley.14942.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.19/5 by 26 [2]. Said about its sound: Right channel dropout on track D3t05 was crossfaded from the left [2]
- **gd1977-05-13.sbd.unknown.6690.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- A flaw exists in the audio during the final part of Goin' Down The Road [6]
- Jack-A-Roe was played for the first time, slower than later versions [9]
- This was the listener's first live Grateful Dead show [15]
- WXRT, the Chicago-based radio station, likely oversaw the concert print [19]
- Viewed as a classic moment, flanking the famous May 8th peak [11]
- Among many spring 1977 shows, this performance is highlighted [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-05-13.sbd.miller.9393.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: This copy is cleaner than the circulating radio tape and is pre-FM; A friend recorded the show live off the Chicago radio broadcast; Seeded to etree by Charlie Miller; SBD to CD via Sonic Solutions [1][6][13]
- **gd1977-05-13.sbd.ashley.14942.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>Dat>>CDA>>SS>>CDA>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA [2]. Also: Digitally remastered in 2002 using a custom Dual-DAW nicknamed Bertha [2]
- **gd1977-05-13.sbd.unknown.6690.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by unknown; source: Pre-FM > Master Reel > DAT > CD [3]
